actual_request.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one transparent full-body game sprite 10_crimson_spear_girl NW09, at least 1024x1024 native.

Redraw BOTH legs into the opposite-foot contact of walking AWAY towards UPPER LEFT. The anatomical RIGHT leg, FAR from camera, must now step FORWARD UPPER-LEFT and land. The anatomical LEFT leg, NEAR camera, must stretch BACK LOWER-RIGHT with toe still touching ground and heel slightly raised.
Far RIGHT thigh starts behind the skirt at the screen-right hip, travels down-left BEHIND the near thigh, and ends in the forward/leftmost boot placed slightly HIGHER on the far ground track. Near LEFT thigh starts at the screen-left hip, crosses IN FRONT in projection, travels gently down-right to the rear/rightmost boot placed LOWER on the near track. Both knees remain relaxed, no high lift. Make these leg connections unmistakable. Do not retain the input's left near boot as the forward foot.
Both boots face upper-left naturally for this rear view. Two contacts, a calm short walking stride. Not a crossed-ankle pose or back kick; very little visible sole. Exact original short chibi legs and red-white-gold boots. Entire spear, hair, toes and butt inside margins. Actual transparent alpha. No ground, shadow, checkerboard, text, diagram or effect. Highest visual finish.
